title: Implement persistent chat history storage
description:
Before editing, inspect:
1. Check existing database models in models.py
2. Verify chat route implementation in app.py

Implement persistent message storage backend:
- Add ChatMessage model to models.py with fields: id, user_id, content, timestamp
- Update chat route in app.py to save messages to database
- Modify /messages endpoint to retrieve full history

Maintain existing WebSocket interface while adding this persistent layer.
acceptance_criteria: models.py contains ChatMessage model with correct fields
app.py saves incoming messages to database at /chat endpoint
GET /messages returns full history from database
